:= by

    apply exists.intro
    exact n
    split
    · exact hn
    · exact ⟨n, by rw [one_mul]; exact nat.prime.nat_of_prime n⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := h1
  have hp4 : p.Prime := by
    rw [hp2]
    exact nat.prime_of_dvd_of_pos hp3
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hp3
  have hp5 : p ∣ n := by
    by_cases h : p = d
    · rw [h]
      exact dvd_refl n
    · obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := hd

        exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hd'
      exact hp5' ▸ hd
  exact ⟨p, hp4, hp5⟩
